profile: a.k.a. Brands Holding Corp. owns a portfolio of fashion brands: Princess Polly, Petal & Pup, Culture Kings, and mnml. The brands offer women’s fashion, streetwear, and related products through online channels, stores, and wholesale partners. Their customers include younger consumers seeking trend-led apparel, as well as shoppers interested in women’s lifestyle collections and streetwear from owned and third-party brands.
